fix: Add app.set('trust proxy', 1) near the top of app.js. Tells Express to trust the single Render reverse-proxy hop, so X-Forwarded-For is honored and req.ip resolves to the real client IP. Stops the express-rate-limit ValidationError noise + makes rate limits correctly per-client-IP instead of globally bucketing through the proxy IP.
